SASBDB entry SASDEM7  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDEM7/)

Human glycine decarboxylase (GLDC, P-protein of the glycine cleavage system, UniProt
P23378 residues 45-1020, homodimer 2 x 109.4 kDa), 5.00 mg/ml, single concentration, in
10 mM Tris pH 7.5, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, 100 mM glycine. ESRF BM29, Pilatus 1M, 2.864 m,
wavelength 0.099 nm, 20 degC, 10 x 0.5 s frames, solvent blank subtracted.
SASBDB lists no publication, no fit and no model for this entry.
Files:
  experimental_data/SASDEM7.dat   https://www.sasbdb.org/media/intensities_files/SASDEM7.dat,
                                  unmodified (q in nm^-1, I in arbitrary units, sigma)
  SASDEM7_6I35_AB.pdb             NOT a SASDEM7 file: made from PDB 6I35 (human GLDC with
                                  pyridoxyl-glycine 5'-phosphate PLG, 2.00 A, files.rcsb.org)
                                  by a plain text selection: the ATOM records of chains A and
                                  B (the biological dimer, REMARK 350 biomolecule 1) and the
                                  HETATM records of the residue PLG of A and B; TER after
                                  each chain, END. Waters and the crystallization additives
                                  EDO, GOL, PEG, BCT are left out; no REMARK lines;
                                  coordinates untouched. The SEQRES of 6I35 (984 residues:
                                  Met44, UniProt 45-1020, Gly + 6 His) equals the sequence
                                  SASBDB gives for the entry. Located residues: chain A
                                  49-1005 without 502-505, chain B 51-1004.
There is no deposited fit, so there is no reference curve.
The fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDEM7/ states the conditions it takes from the
entry and why 6I35 (not 6I33, not the Neanderthal 6I34) was chosen.
